sessions.phase_label: Logo concept development, refinement, approval, and final asset delivery

requirements.title: Initial Logo Concepts
requirements.definition: Produce multiple original initial logo concepts after reviewing the client's supplied references and direction.
requirements.boundary_note: Concept count and reference use are attributes of one concept-development deliverable; revision scheduling and offer-acceptance timing are project process rather than separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Logo Brand Wording
requirements.definition: The logo must identify the business as Copper Crust, omit the word 'truck', and remain suitable for the wider business rather than representing only the catering truck.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers company-name content and the explicit exclusion of 'truck'; strapline content and visual styling are independently adjustable and remain separate.

requirements.title: Logo Strapline
requirements.definition: Include the established company strapline and apply its independently selected line, contrast, and colour treatment.
requirements.boundary_note: The strapline can be restyled or changed without changing the company-name lettering, symbol, or overall deliverable package.

requirements.title: Logo Visual Style
requirements.definition: Maintain a clean, distinctive, professional and authentic visual style without making the logo excessively ornate or reducing its refined appearance.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the overall style constraint; exact letterforms, colours, symbol construction, and approved composition are independently actionable sibling Requirements.

requirements.title: Logo Symbol Treatment
requirements.definition: Use only a subtle graphic treatment and ensure the flame-based element is recognizable as the intended letter O rather than an ambiguous standalone flame.
requirements.boundary_note: The flame/O construction has its own alternatives and recognition criterion, so it is separate from typography, colour, and strapline styling.

requirements.title: Logo Letterform Design
requirements.definition: Use distinctive custom lettering with controlled character, including the approved proportions and mirrored decorative features of the DOUGH and GLOBAL letterforms.
requirements.boundary_note: Letter height and decorative details are attributes of one custom-letterform mechanism; companion font recommendations for other materials are a separate deliverable.

requirements.title: Logo Colour Treatment
requirements.definition: Apply the approved graduated-orange and black treatment to the main logo elements, including graduated orange for GLOBAL and the strapline and black for DOUGH.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers colours within the approved main artwork; delivery of separate full-colour, black, and white variants and documentation of colour codes are separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Cross-Media Logo Suitability
requirements.definition: Keep the logo clean, readable and versatile across online use, social media, the catering truck, signage, menus, banners, uniforms and other print applications.
requirements.boundary_note: This is the acceptance constraint governing legibility and versatility across uses, not the technical obligation to supply any particular file format.

requirements.title: Approved Final Logo Composition
requirements.definition: Use the client-selected rev8-11 composition as the approved final logo design baseline.
requirements.boundary_note: Captures selection of the overall final composition while leaving colour, letterform, symbol, strapline, and export-variant rules with their independently evolving Requirements.

requirements.title: Logo Background Variants
requirements.definition: Supply the approved logo both with the black-box background and without that background for uses where the box is unsuitable.
requirements.boundary_note: Background presence is independently selectable and is not merely another colour variant or file format.

requirements.title: Standard Logo Colour Variants
requirements.definition: Supply the three requested logo variants: standard full colour, black, and white.
requirements.boundary_note: The three variants form one tightly coupled export set; historical exploratory colour versions are explicitly outside the requested final set.

requirements.title: Editable Logo Source Files
requirements.definition: Supply editable source and vector logo files suitable for professional modification and print production, including the requested AI, EPS and related source formats.
requirements.boundary_note: Editable/vector sources have distinct software requirements and acceptance behavior from transparent PNG and standard preview exports.

requirements.title: Transparent PNG Logo Exports
requirements.definition: Supply usable PNG exports of the required logo variants with transparent backgrounds and artwork that displays correctly in compatible viewers.
requirements.boundary_note: PNG exports have a separate observed failure and investigation trajectory, so they are not merged with editable source files or working JPG/PDF exports.

requirements.title: Standard Logo Preview and Print Exports
requirements.definition: Supply standard non-editable logo exports such as JPG and PDF files for viewing, online use and print workflows.
requirements.boundary_note: These formats were independently reported as usable while PNG and editable-source concerns remained, supporting a separate acceptance unit.

requirements.title: Brand Colour Specification
requirements.definition: Provide accessible documentation of the approved brand colours and their colour codes so the identity can be reproduced consistently.
requirements.boundary_note: This is the promised colour-reference deliverable, not a comprehensive paid brand-guidelines project and not the colour treatment of the logo artwork itself.

requirements.title: Brand Font Guidance
requirements.definition: Explain whether the logo lettering uses an existing or custom typeface and provide complementary font recommendations for website headings and other brand materials.
requirements.boundary_note: Font guidance for future materials is independently deliverable from the custom letterform design embedded in the logo.

requirements.title: Original and Trademark-Suitable Logo
requirements.definition: The final logo must be original and suitable for future trademark use rather than copied, stock, template-based, copyrighted, or AI-generated artwork.
requirements.boundary_note: Originality and trademark suitability constrain the produced artwork; transfer or written confirmation of ownership is a separate legal obligation.

requirements.title: Logo Copyright Ownership Confirmation
requirements.definition: Ensure the client owns the completed logo copyright and provide written confirmation suitable for retention and future trademark activity.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers ownership and its written confirmation; the freelancer's proposed certificate price and contact-detail collection are administrative attributes or follow-up steps, not separate Requirements.
